# h05_telescope_prod

Prove the telescoping product identity: for every integer $n \ge 2$,

$$\prod_{k=2}^{n} \left(1 - \frac{1}{k^2}\right) = \frac{n+1}{2n}.$$

The product is over the real numbers.
